people.imagined: On a salt-marsh dyke at low tide, planting rice seed in grey mud, punt-pole on her shoulder. She squints against the glare as her father did, sure the marsh will grow rice.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a salt-marsh dyke at low tide in a pearl glare, she squints toward the horizon with a hopeful, stubborn look, a long punt-pole over her right shoulder. Face, most important: the long pole of pale tempered bamboo, its iron-shod foot at the top edge of the frame, and white salt crystals sparkling in her thick braid. A tall, sun-dark woman of thirty-two with a long jaw, dark brown skin, steady dark eyes, thick straight brows and a wide frank mouth; fine sun-lines fan from her eyes, her lower lip is split at one corner by salt wind, and a faint tan-line shows where a straw hat once sat. Hair: black, in one long thick braid over the shoulder, salt-whitened at the ends, a jade hairpin at the crown. Body: tall, long-armed, strong. Clothing: three layers of green-grey silk dyed with haze indigo, softened to sage at the shoulders, the crossed collars edged in silver embroidered reeds and mist; the true disciple's pale green silk collar rimmed with a thin line of salt; a translucent green gauze over-robe drifting like marsh haze, the wide sleeves tied up above the elbow with green cords; a jade herb pendant at her sash. Hands: one hand steadies the pole, the other pinches a few glowing grains of rice seed. Power: a faint blue-green water-mist curls about her feet, tiny green motes rising from the seed. Background: grey mud flats shining like mirrors, low dykes cutting them into rectangles, a single heron in a shallow pool, a thread of smoke from a distant salt-boiler's hut. Light: silver spirit-light from a low pale sun, soft rim light on the braid. Expression: squinted eyes against the glare, a stubborn jaw and a small determined smile.

people.imagined: A foundling prodigy at his master's table, quick hands crossing a needle through the air, fixed look on the viewer. He wonders who left him on the step.
people.subject: The moment: at a medicine table lit by a single lamp, he stops with a thin gold-tipped needle upright between two fingers and fixes the viewer with an unwavering stare, measuring them, wondering who left him on the step. Face, most important: a strip of faded older green silk sewn inside his collar, showing as a pale pond-leaf edge at the neck, and the long steel needle held upright. A thin, sharp-boned, pale face of thirty-four with narrow intense dark eyes that do not blink, straight thin brows, a straight nose, a closed thin mouth and a faint vertical crease between the brows. Hair: black, in a tight topknot held by a slim white-jade pin. Body: slim, upright, ready. Clothing: graceful green-grey silk in two layers, exactly pressed, the inner-gate pale green silk collar closed to the throat over the old faded strip with tiny darker hand stitches, narrow wide-cut sleeves with silver herb embroidery at the cuffs, a dark green cord sash and a small flat needle case hung with a jade bead. Hands and objects: the needle raised in his right hand, the left flat beside a few dried polygala roots, the nails short and square. Power: a thin pale green sheen runs along the needle, a few wood-green motes drifting off it. Background: shelves of squat grey-glazed jars dissolving into shadow, a bundle of dried polygala, a brass scale, a paper window casting a cool square of moonlight. Light: cool silver moon-glow from the upper left, a faint green rim on his cheek. Expression: ambitious and intense, a watchful stillness, the stare of a foundling who has learned that people are to be read.

people.imagined: The outer-gate master in a spirit field at morning, leaning on his hoe and pointing with it. He has waited forty years for one Earth-only disciple to pass.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a spirit field at misty dawn, he leans both hands on a long hoe and points its blade toward a distant row, patient; he has waited forty years for one Earth-only disciple to pass. Face, most important: a grey beard cut square at the chest, and the long wooden hoe used as staff and pointer, its iron blade honed bright. A broad, slow, brown-weathered face of about fifty-eight, deep furrows at the brow, small kind brown eyes, heavy grey brows, a blunt nose, a quiet mouth, deep creases from nose to mouth corners, large ears with grey hair in them. Hair: iron grey, in a plain knot under a wide straw hat hanging behind his neck on a cord, a pale jade pin through the knot. Body: stocky, bowed shoulders, solid. Clothing: a steward's robe of green-grey silk, darkened to slate at the hem by dew, the crossed collars edged in silver embroidered sprouts, wide sleeves bound at the wrists with simple brown field-cuffs, a broad grey-green sash with a jade herb pendant, the master's quiet dignity without show. Hands: both hands on the hoe, the handle smooth and dark, the hand-backs freckled with age. Power: a faint brown-green earth haze lies low round his feet, with a few gold motes drifting from the furrows. Background: terraced spirit fields stepping down the hillside in neat green rows, a stone marker at each terrace end, low mist in the furrows, a few crows on an edge. Light: pearly spirit-light of early morning from the upper left, soft rim light on the beard. Expression: patient and humble, the unhurried look of a man who has outwaited everything.

people.imagined: At a meeting in the seed vault, her knee jiggling under the table; she is afraid she will not reach the next stage. Seeds in a bowl before her.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a low table in a vault of seed jars, she looks up with an anxious smile, shoulders rocking as a knee jiggles under the table; she is afraid she will not reach the next stage. Face, most important: a round freckled face with pale-gold freckles across nose, cheeks and even eyelids, soft and open. About thirty-eight, fair, warm brown eyes, soft straight brows, a short nose, ears pink at the tips from nerves, a wavering friendly mouth with the lower lip slightly bitten. Hair: light brown, in a thick low braid pinned up with a green silk cord and a small jade comb. Body: round, small, shoulders lifted. Clothing: soft pale green-grey silk robes in layers, the inner-gate pale green silk collar loosely knotted, a green gauze over-robe with silver seed-and-leaf embroidery at the hem, sleeves folded back once to show faint ink smudges at her wrists, a dark green cord sash with a brass key on a red tassel swinging at her chest. Hands and objects: both hands cup a small celadon bowl of pale seeds that glow faintly. Power: wood-green motes sparkle up from the seeds like fireflies. Background: shelves of lidded glazed jars in three sizes, brown and green, each with a knotted cord at its neck, fading into dark; a paper lantern glows from a rafter. Light: soft lantern light from the upper left, mist-gold glow in the seeds, a faint rim light on the braid. Expression: a hopeful, uncertain smile that asks to be liked, wary eyes that want to trust.

people.imagined: On the ridge at dusk the steward walks with two buckets on a yoke, watering the life trees. He almost never speaks; he wants to be buried among them.
people.subject: The moment: on a mountain ridge at dusk, he trudges toward the viewer with a wooden yoke across his shoulders and a bucket hanging at each side, silent, watering the life trees; he wants to be buried among them. Face, most important: the carrying yoke across both shoulders with two wooden buckets dripping at the frame's edges, and a deeply stooped, weathered face. About sixty-five, dark leathery skin, small steady black eyes under drooping lids, heavy grey brows, a long nose, a closed thin mouth, hollowed cheeks, folds at the neck and a pale old scar across the chin. Hair: thin white, in a short tail tied with a faded green ribbon. Body: stooped, long-boned and tough. Clothing: the Cliff Hall's pale ivory-grey silk, clean and stiff with age, in layered crossed collars edged in faded silver pine-and-cloud embroidery, carefully mended at both knees and cuffs in grey thread, a knotted silk-rope sash with a small old jade tassel, the quiet dignity of a steward of the founder's grave. Hands and objects: gripping the yoke ropes, the yoke worn glossy where it rests on his shoulders with a folded cloth beneath. Power: a faint green-brown mist gathers at his feet and soft green motes drift upward from the water. Background: a line of small saplings marked with knotted cords climbing the ridge, an ancient pine bending sideways against a lavender sky, mist filling the valley. Light: low gold dusk light from the upper left, a thin spirit-glow rim along his shoulders. Expression: loyal and patient, withdrawn, a silent inward face that has said what it has to say to the trees.

people.imagined: She sits at the edge of a still pool with both burn-scarred hands in the water, watching the surface. She wants to die by water and teach the method to one person.
people.subject: The moment: sitting at the edge of a still moonlit pool she looks up from her reflection, calm, both hands resting in the water; she wants to die by water and teach the method to one person. Face, most important: both hands marked with pale shiny burn-scars up to the wrist, resting half in clear water, and her reflection unmoving in the pool. A pale, thin, composed face of about sixty, skin like milk with fine lines at the eyes, a band of pale shiny scar tissue from the left temple into the hairline, pale grey eyes, long lashes, level brows, a straight nose, a thin quiet mouth, a stillness almost like a painted figure. Hair: black, loose to the shoulders, a single green cord at the temple and a plain wooden comb at the nape. Body: slender and still. Clothing: layered green-grey inner-gate silk with a pale green silk collar, a grey-blue translucent gauze over-robe floating on the water like mist, wide sleeves pushed above the wrists, a grey-blue cord sash holding the crossed collar, hems dark with wet, silver mirror-and-ripple embroidery at the borders. Hands: both in the water, the scars glossy along bare forearms. Power: a pale blue sheen lies on the water, thin rings of light spreading from her fingers, a few blue motes lifting. Background: a green-grey pool rimmed with smooth stones and ferns, a single leaf floating on glass-flat water, the far bank dissolving into soft green mist. Light: cool silver moonlight from the upper left, water glints on her face. Expression: calm and reclusive, a still closed look as if the water were the only listener.

people.imagined: The herder in his last two years at Trúc Cơ, sitting under the cattle's tree with a flute, the herd listening. He wants Kết Đan in spring or a quiet place.
people.subject: The moment: sitting under a great tree with a bamboo flute lowered from his lips, listening to the herd that stands about him in the evening. Face, most important: missing teeth on one side, so a pronounced hollow at the left cheek and a gap in his smile, and a bamboo flute thrust through his belt. Appearing about sixty-five, brown, deeply weathered, sharp bright dark eyes, white eyebrows, a broad flat nose, a wide partly toothless smile; the toothless cheek is sunken so the cheekbone stands like a ridge, and his eyes crinkle almost shut when he smiles. Hair: white, long, in a low tail with a green cord and a plain jade bead. Body: thin, spare, long-limbed. Clothing: a robe of soft green-grey silk faded near to grey with washing, in two crossed collars, mended at the hem in brown thread, a translucent grey-green gauze over-robe, wide sleeves bound at the forearms with polished herder's arm-guards, a worn silk-rope belt holding the flute, whose bamboo is darkened by decades of handling. Hands: the flute lowered in the right hand; at his knee stands Lão Hoàng, the dun lead cow, a spirit beast with one horn broken short. Power: a faint green-gold haze drifts about him, a few gold motes settling on the cattle's backs, the glow of a Trúc Cơ in his last years. Background: the broad shapes of resting spirit cattle in the shade of the huge old tree, a calf among the roots, golden grass to a distant blue ridge. Light: warm gold spirit-light of late sun from the upper left, soft rim light on his white hair. Expression: content and listening, with a quiet wistful hunger in the eyes, lips slightly parted.

people.imagined: In the port-house office, ink on his middle finger, the abacus in his sleeve, adding the price of every pill in the cape in his head and the lintel of his clan hall.
people.subject: The moment: at a port-house desk at night, he looks up from a column of figures with a bland, courteous expression while his fingers move as if over beads. Face, most important: a black ink stain across the middle finger of the raised right hand, and the rosewood frame of an abacus poking from his sleeve. A neat, clean-shaven, pale face of thirty-five, sleek dark brows, sharp small dark eyes, a straight nose, a polite flat smile, a faint ink line at the edge of his chin and a small dark mole near the left corner of his mouth. Hair: black, oiled, in a tight neat topknot with a jade pin. Body: slight, precise, upright. Clothing: sharply pressed green-grey silk robes in layers, the sleeves holding fine creases, the green silk port-house collar band embroidered with thin silver waves, a translucent green gauze over-robe, a dark grey silk sash with a small jade toggle and a jade herb pendant. Hands: one hand holds a brush over a ledger of columns, the other shows the abacus frame, brass-edged. Power: a faint blue-green water haze curls round the desk and a few pale blue motes drift over the ledgers. Background: a latticed window behind him with masts and the grey-blue glimmer of a harbour under the moon, a shelf of ledgers bound in blue cloth, a small brass scale at the desk edge. Light: cool silvery moonlight from the window at the upper left, a warm glow from a paper lamp on the desk. Expression: a bland, courteous face with a polite half-smile while the eyes move quickly, tallying.

people.imagined: In the furnace hall, thin and very still, perilla-purple on her fingertips, admired and cold. A sealed shelf is behind her, and she stands to hide it.
people.subject: The moment: standing perfectly still before a lacquered shelf in the furnace hall, she looks at the viewer with a cold level gaze, keeping herself between them and the shelf. Face, most important: bright perilla-purple stains on her fingertips and nails, both hands clasped at her waist, and a very thin, sharp-boned face. A narrow face of about thirty-five, pale grey skin, dark cool eyes, straight thin brows, a sharp nose, a closed nearly colourless mouth, faint hollows under the cheekbones and a delicate vertical line between the brows like a ruled stroke. Hair: black, in a severe tight knot with a green jade pin. Body: very thin, tall, rigid. Clothing: immaculate green-grey silk in three crossed layers, pressed too perfectly for a furnace hall, the senior inner alchemist's green silk collar edged with silver herb-and-flame embroidery, a translucent dark green gauze over-robe, sleeves tied back at the elbow with a plain cord, a dark green sash hung with a jade herb pendant. Hands: clasped, the purple running from the fingertips to the first knuckle like dye. Power: a faint green-purple haze gathers about her hands, thin violet wisps curling at her sleeves, cold and controlled. Background: behind her a tall lacquered shelf with a black latch stands closed; beyond it a furnace mouth glows soft green and a ladder of iron tongs hangs on the wall in shadow. Light: green furnace-light from the lower left, dark at the right, a thin cold rim along her jaw. Expression: a cold composed face with a level gaze and a still closed mouth, tension only in the shoulders.

people.imagined: The founder's descendant on the ridge, fed up with being a relic, looking out with the founder's long eyes and wanting to grow magnolias like anyone.
people.subject: The moment: standing on the ridge at dawn, she turns away from an unseen elder with a flash of impatience, then back to the viewer with a restless, hopeful look; she is fed up with being a relic and wants to grow magnolias like anyone. Face, most important: very long, narrow, upturned eyes, the founder's eyes, dark and bright, in a small delicate face. About twenty-four, pale gold skin, thin arched brows, a small straight nose, a quick wry mouth with the upper lip slightly short so the lips sit just parted, a faint blush of impatience on the cheekbones. Hair: black, long and loose to the waist, a single magnolia bud at the ear and a thin jade hairband. Body: slight, quick, light. Clothing: the Cliff Hall's pale ivory silk, crisp and unnaturally fine, spotless but for small garden-dirt marks, in layered crossed collars with the green-silk collar band loosened, a drifting ivory gauze over-robe embroidered with silver pine and magnolia, the relic's sash tied in a careless knot, sleeves pushed above the elbow, a small jade tassel of the founder's line at her belt. Hands and objects: one hand holds a small magnolia sapling in a clay pot. Power: a pale green sparkle on the leaves, soft wood-green motes lifting from the pot, a faint bright aura of an old lineage. Background: a ridge of ancient pines rising through mist, a moss-covered stone lantern, a row of tiny pots of magnolia seedlings on a low wall. Light: pale pearl dawn spirit-light from the upper left, a gentle glowing rim on her hair. Expression: impatient and restless, a bit sly, the quick wry look of a girl who has run out of patience with being looked at.

people.imagined: The hardest fighter on the ridge holds out his hands, pine soot ground in every line, as if daring someone to laugh at his Metal.
people.subject: The moment: braced on a bare ridge, he looks at the viewer with narrowed eyes, both hands held open and forward, palms out, daring them to laugh at his Metal. Face, most important: palms black with pine soot in every line and crease, held wide, and a hard, heavy-jawed face. About thirty-five, dark weathered skin, narrow grey eyes, thick straight brows with a scar notching one, a flat broken nose, thin tight lips pushed out as if chewing something bitter, heavy ears flattened at the tops. Hair: black, cropped very short. Body: massive shoulders on a short thick neck, solid as a stump. Clothing: the Cliff Hall's pale ivory-grey silk robe in layered collars, clean, with a close-cut sleeveless over-vest of dark silk brocade stitched in black thread with silver cloud-and-pine borders, a broad dark sash with a steel-grey jade clasp, plain brass bracers dented by blows on his forearms, shining with a faint steel sheen. Hands: held out stiff and open, fingers spread. Power: a cold steel-white sheen along the bracers, fine pale metal motes glinting about his fists, a fighter's pressure in the air. Background: a bare rock ridge of grey slabs cutting a pale sky, one lone pine standing crooked in the gap, thin mist at its foot. Light: hard silver spirit-light from the upper left, a bright steel-grey gleam at the bracers, a thin rim light along the heavy jaw. Expression: brave and cruel, a hard daring set to the mouth, the stare of the hardest fighter on the ridge.

people.imagined: She smooths a passing sleeve without thinking, a cloth-seller's habit, her hands quick. She has never forgotten a face on the list.
people.subject: The moment: reaching out to smooth the sleeve of the viewer with quick light fingers, smiling warmly, a cloth-seller's habit; she has never forgotten a face on the list. Face, most important: two long, slender, quick hands in the foreground smoothing a sleeve, and a warm, bright, remembering face. A round, friendly face of thirty-four, golden-brown, bright dark eyes that look straight at one, long curled lashes, soft arched brows, a small nose, a quick wide smile with tiny laugh-lines, a small gold stud in one earlobe. Hair: black, in a loose bun with a green silk ribbon and a silver hairpin. Body: small, quick, gracious. Clothing: layered green-grey silk with seamstress-perfect hems, the inner-gate pale green silk collar smoothed flat, a green gauze over-robe embroidered in silver at the borders with clouds and tiny doors, a bright yellow silk tape measure round her neck like a ribbon, a silver thimble ring glinting on her right forefinger, a dark green cord sash with a jade tassel. Hands: smoothing a fold of fabric. Power: a soft green warmth glows round her fingers, a few green motes lifting from the cloth. Background: a bright green-painted door in a whitewashed wall softened by mist, a rack of folded cloth bolts, red paper lanterns glowing under the eaves. Light: warm lantern glow from the upper left mixed with soft moonlight, a gentle rim along her cheek. Expression: a warm, quick smile with bright, remembering eyes and an easy generous mouth.

people.imagined: On the osmanthus terraces she copies a book before the paper rots, her right thumb cramped into a hook around the brush.
people.subject: The moment: seated among osmanthus trees at twilight, she looks up from copying with a mild, unhurried gaze, the brush still in her hand. Face, most important: her right thumb cramped into a stiff hook round the brush shaft, plainly crooked and thick-knuckled, held up, and a tiny cluster of osmanthus flowers tucked in her hair. A quiet, plain, oval face of thirty-five, light brown skin, patient dark eyes slightly bloodshot from long copying, thin straight brows, a straight nose, a modest closed mouth, an ink-dot freckle by her nose, lilac shadows beneath her eyes. Hair: black, in a plain bun with a few golden osmanthus flowers and a jade pin. Body: slim, a little stooped. Clothing: soft green-grey silk robes in layers with the pale green silk collar peeking at the neck, a translucent pale gauze over-robe with ink-spotted hems, the wide sleeves tied back with cord, silver herb-and-leaf embroidery at the cuffs, a small felt wrist-pad on a green tassel at her belt. Hands: the hooked thumb holding a brush over a bound book. Power: a faint green-gold sparkle drifts about the page, soft wood-green motes rising from the ink. Background: terraced slopes of osmanthus trees in rows, their tiny gold flowers like scattered coins, a low table with a bound book and a stone ink slab under a straw canopy, mist between the terraces. Light: soft spirit-light of dusk from the upper left, a paper lamp glow on the page, a gentle rim on her hair. Expression: a mild, unhurried gaze with soft patient eyes and a modest steady mouth.

people.imagined: A wheat farmer's son, smiling slowly, a beat after everyone else has stopped, with earth on his hands from a plough.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a golden field in afternoon light, his smile spreads slowly across his face a beat after everyone else has finished laughing, a hand resting on a plough handle. Face, most important: a broad slow smile just beginning, late, on an open round face, and a plough handle gripped in his left hand at the lower edge. A big, sunburnt, good-natured face of thirty-two, ruddy brown, round light brown eyes, thick sandy brows, a blunt nose, a wide gentle mouth, round freckled cheeks, ears that stick out a little, eye corners creasing deeply. Hair: sandy brown, short and bristly, with wheat chaff in it. Body: big, thick-armed, calm. Clothing: a clean green-grey silk robe cut short and sturdy at the sleeve for field work but still graceful, with the inner-gate collar edged in silver sprout embroidery, soaked darker at the hem, a green cord sash holding a small jade-stoppered water flask, old yellow plough-grease on the right thigh. Hands and objects: a hand on the plough handle, the strong wrists tanned several shades darker than the forearms, earth on his fingers. Power: a faint green-gold dust shimmers in the air above the furrows, small gold motes rising from the soil. Background: golden wheat stretching to a line of dark hills, a single ox harnessed to a plough at the field's edge, a few soft clouds in a pale sky. Light: warm gold spirit-light from the upper left, a glowing rim along his sandy hair. Expression: an unhurried, delighted smile arriving at its own pace, easy and steady eyes.

people.imagined: On the river-mouth ice, the best fighter on it, with a hoarfrost-white patch in his left eyebrow. He has just let someone else wear his fur, and does not regret it.
people.subject: The moment: standing on river-mouth ice at dusk, he glances back over his shoulder with a hard, assessing look, breath steaming; he has just let someone else wear his fur, and does not regret it. Face, most important: a hoarfrost-white patch in his left eyebrow, snowy against the black hair and glittering like salt, and a thick fur collar of the river-mouth watch at his throat. A lean, hard, handsome face of thirty-six, wind-chapped brown, red-chapped cheeks, narrow dark eyes, a straight nose with a thin white line of old frostbite at the tip, a firm mouth. Hair: black, tied back in a tight tail with a silver ring. Body: lean, springy, balanced. Clothing: green-grey silk robes stiff with frost at the hem under a heavy grey fur-collared coat of brocade, the collar thick and tied with a silk cord, a Cold Ford Hall blue-green sash with its ends tucked and a jade pendant, silver wave embroidery at the cuffs, bracers strapped over the sleeves. Hands and objects: a short iron-shod ice spike in one hand. Power: a blue frost shimmer round the spike, his breath hanging as a white plume, tiny ice motes glittering about his shoulders. Background: a wide frozen river mouth in pale blue-white, a few wooden watch posts, a dark thread of open water in the middle distance under a low violet sky. Light: cold moon-blue spirit-light from the upper left, a bright silver rim along the fur. Expression: warlike and loyal, callous, a hard level assessing stare, the best fighter on the ice.

people.imagined: A ferryman's daughter on the river mouth, a small dry cough hidden in her sleeve, carrying a letter she will not read.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a ferry landing in drizzle at dusk, she coughs very softly into her sleeve and hides it, looking up steadily. Face, most important: her sleeve held against her mouth, and a sealed letter without any writing mark tucked in her other hand. A small, plain, kind face of thirty-three, pale skin, shadowed grey-brown eyes, thin straight brows, a small nose, a modest mouth; a slight hectic flush on the cheeks, dry cracked lips, a strand of hair stuck damp to her temple. Hair: black, in a plain low knot with a river-reed pin of pale jade. Body: small, thin, upright. Clothing: clean green-grey silk robes, a short oiled-silk cape glossy and beaded with water over them, a pale blue Cold Ford sash tied in a flat ferry knot, silver wave embroidery at the collar, a slim mail pouch across her chest on a blue tassel; one sleeve is darker where she has coughed into it, the hem damp. Hands: one holds her sleeve to her lips, the other the folded paper. Power: a faint blue water hint, tiny pale droplets glowing as they hang in the air about her. Background: behind her a flat-bottomed ferry moored against a plank landing, a pole upright in the water, the far bank a pale smudge in drizzling mist. Light: soft grey-silver spirit-light diffused from the upper left, a gentle rim on her wet hair. Expression: a steady, careful look with a hidden small cough tightening the lips, honest eyes lifted.

people.imagined: A one-time thief in the marten yard, holding a pup that scratched her wrist; a fresh red line is always on it. She names every pup and cries when they're sold.
people.subject: The moment: cradling a small marten pup against her chest in warm lamplit evening, looking down at it with soft eyes as it grips her wrist; she names every pup and cries when they are sold. Face, most important: a fresh red claw scratch on the back of her wrist, and the sleek brown marten pup with a cream bib held against her. A quick, pointed, freckled face of thirty-two, olive, large dark eyes with a gleam, long dark lashes, thin arched brows, a small nose, a small old scar nicking the upper lip, a gentle smile. Hair: dark brown, cut short and uneven, with a green cord and a tiny jade bead. Body: lithe and small. Clothing: green-grey silk robes in layers with the sleeves rolled and held by a neat band of green silk, a marten-brown fur trim at the collar with a few hairs clinging to it, a translucent green gauze over-robe, silver embroidery of paw-prints and leaves at the borders, a green cord sash with a small jade charm, a scratched glove on the other hand. Hands and objects: the pup in one arm, its claws hooked into the cuff, the scratched wrist visible. Power: a faint green-gold warmth glows round the pup and her arms, tiny gold motes drifting. Background: rows of wooden hutches with straw, small brown shapes of martens peering from holes, a pine fence fading into dark mist. Light: warm yellow lantern-light from the upper left, a soft glowing rim on her short hair. Expression: a tender, soft absorbed smile wholly for the pup, eyes bright and warm.

people.imagined: The steward of the spirit-wood stores sniffs every lamp that passes, rescued as a child from a burning resin store. He stands at the door of the sheds and will not let a flame in.
people.subject: The moment: at the door of a wood shed at night he sniffs the air toward a passing lamp, nostrils flared, alarmed, holding out a flat hand to stop it; as a child he was rescued from a burning resin store. Face, most important: nostrils flared in mid-sniff, and a raised flat hand warning off a lamp. A pinched, lined, anxious face of about thirty-eight, pale, wide watchful red-rimmed brown eyes, thin pale brows, a long thin nose, a tight mouth and a thin old burn mark on the left jaw. Hair: thin black with early grey, in a short knot with a plain jade pin. Body: lean and tense. Clothing: a green-grey silk robe buttoned to the throat, wet cloth wrapped round the cuffs against sparks, a pale clay-grey over-vest of fire-proofed silk with silver embroidered flame-ward marks at the hem, a small iron bucket on a green tassel at the belt, gloves tucked in a dark green cord sash. Hands: the other gloved hand clutches a sand-bucket handle at his belt. Power: a faint green-brown resin haze hangs in the air, a few wood-green motes clinging to the log stacks. Background: a dark shed filled with tall stacks of cut spirit-wood logs, each bound with grey rope, sand buckets along the wall, a lantern glow beyond the door held far away. Light: cool pale moon-glow from the upper left, the far lamp throwing a thin warm edge on his raised palm. Expression: cautious and diligent, a paranoid watchful tension in the pinched mouth and wide eyes, the look of a man who does not trust a flame.

people.imagined: The envoy's letter-writer, sitting so straight a ruler looks bent beside her, brush poised in a beautiful hand.
people.subject: The moment: sitting at a writing desk with perfectly vertical posture, brush lifted, she looks up with courteous calm. Face, most important: a perfectly straight spine and head carriage in an upright seated pose, a brush held lightly in a fine hand. A composed, oval, honest face of forty, pale gold skin, calm dark eyes, level brows, a straight nose, a small even smile; her brows are thin and perfectly level, her skin smooth without a line, her lips slightly pursed in concentration. Hair: black, in a flawless smooth coil with a jade pin and a pale blue ribbon. Body: slim, absolutely upright. Clothing: finely pressed green-grey silk without a crease at any point, the pale green silk collar smooth as paper, a pale blue gauze over-robe flowing straight from her shoulders, narrow sleeves bound at the wrist with silver-grey cord and embroidered at the cuffs with mist and herbs, a pale blue silk sash with a flat jade pendant. Hands: a brush over a blank sheet, an ink stone beside. Power: a faint blue-green hint drifts from the brush tip, a few pale motes settling on the paper like dew. Background: behind her a latticed paper window glows pale with moonlight, a tall vase holds a single pine branch, a neat stack of folded letters waits on the table. Light: soft even silver moonlight from the upper left, a gentle rim on her smooth hair. Expression: a courteous, composed face with calm level eyes and a quiet polite mouth.

people.imagined: At dawn he walks the array's stones, tapping each with his ring, listening for the one that hums wrong.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn among standing stones he leans in and taps a pale stone with a thick bronze ring, head tilted to listen for the one that hums wrong. Face, most important: a heavy bronze ring on his right hand tapping the stone, and an ear turned toward it. A broad, trusting, square face of thirty-five, light brown, patient dark eyes, thick bushy black brows, a blunt nose, a calm mouth, a broad jaw stubbled with stone dust, deep forehead lines from long squinting at small marks. Hair: black, in a short tied knot with a little stone dust and a plain jade pin. Body: stocky and steady. Clothing: green-grey silk robes hitched at the sash for walking, the sleeves tied, a pale grey chalk-marked over-vest with silver array-line embroidery, a green array-runner's silk band wound twice round the waist, a coil of knotted cord and a jade bead at the belt. Hands and objects: tapping the stone with the wide plain bronze ring, dented from use. Power: a faint ripple in the air like a green hum, thin rings of pale green light spreading from the stone, a few motes rising. Background: a line of knee-high standing stones, each carved with a small groove, receding along a dew-wet slope in grey dawn mist. Light: pale pearl-grey spirit-light of dawn from the upper left before sunrise, a soft rim on his shoulders. Expression: diligent and calm, trusting, the patient listening face of a man who has all the time the stones need.

people.imagined: The mica-grinder with glitter on her cheekbones and sleeves, clumsy with wood and good with stone, patient at the quern.
people.subject: The moment: at a stone quern in a glittering workshop, she looks up, patient and stubborn, with glitter on her face. Face, most important: glittering mica dust on her cheekbones and the bridge of her nose like silver freckles, and sleeves sparkling. A broad, plain, steady face of thirty-five, tan skin, dark patient eyes, heavy straight brows, a wide nose, a firm mouth; silver mica flecks even her eyelashes, a small crease between her thick brows. Hair: black, in a thick braid wrapped round her head, silvery with dust, a silver pin through it. Body: broad, short, strong forearms. Clothing: green-grey silk robes with sleeves rolled above muscular forearms and shimmering with mica, a dark brocade work over-skirt hung from neck to knee with a pocket of sifted powder, silver array-line embroidery at the collar, a small silk bag of mica at her belt with a jade tassel, its seams sparkling. Hands: a small stone pestle held over a quern of pale flakes. Power: a pale silver-green sparkle swirls from the quern, fine mica motes rising like starlight round her. Background: a workbench of stone querns of various sizes, small jars of powder in silver, pale gold and grey, a window throwing a bright square across the glittering floor. Light: bright silver spirit-light from the upper left glinting off the dust, a soft rim on her braid. Expression: a patient, stubborn look with a small closed smile, glitter sparkling on the cheekbones.

people.imagined: A child-faced healer on a grown frame, practising his old hall's method, wide-eyed and earnest, a healer's calm in a round face.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling beside a patient with two fingers laid lightly on a wrist, he looks up with earnest big eyes, practising his old hall's method. Face, most important: a round child's face with soft plump cheeks and no lines, set on a grown man's broad shoulders and long arms, plainly mismatched. He appears about eighteen in the face, baby-smooth and pink with dimples, large clear wet-bright brown eyes, soft light brows, a button nose, a small honest mouth, a heavy grown jaw beneath. Hair: soft brown, short and fluffy, a green ribbon at the crown. Body: tall, broad-shouldered, gangly. Clothing: green-grey silk robes cut generously for his tall frame, the healing house's pale green silk collar sitting slightly crooked as if dressed by someone else, a pale green gauze over-robe with silver herb embroidery, sleeves tied with cord, a herb pouch at his belt stitched with a child's stitches and a small jade tassel. Hands and objects: two fingers on a patient's wrist. Power: a warm green glow at his fingertips, soft wood-green motes drifting into the patient's sleeve. Background: a healing room with a pallet bed holding a patient under a quilt, jars of herbs hanging from beams, a small oil lamp in a wall niche, mist at the paper window. Light: soft warm lamp-glow from the upper left, a faint green rim on his round cheek. Expression: honest and compassionate, stubborn, a calm wide-eyed healer's patience in a round face.

people.imagined: A small woman at the tea terrace, her deep slow voice surprising for her size; she pours the head's tea slowly.
people.subject: The moment: pouring tea from a small clay pot at the tea terrace, she says something slowly in a surprisingly low voice, calm; she pours the head's tea unhurried. Face, most important: a very small, slight woman with a calm broad forehead, steam rising from the pot she pours, and a deep slow unhurried manner. A small, round, serene face of thirty-five, light brown, half-lidded dark eyes with fine lines at the corners, thin brows, a small nose, a small chin, a gentle closed smile and a faint dusting of green tea-leaf on one cheek. Hair: black, in a low tail wrapped in tea-green silk with a jade pin. Body: tiny, slender and steady, tiny hands. Clothing: soft green-grey silk robes with sleeves tied up by cord, a tea-leaf green gauze over-robe with silver leaf-and-mist embroidery at the borders, a pale green silk collar, a pocket-pouch of dried leaves and a small bamboo whisk hung from the sash with a green tassel. Hands: a small clay teapot, dark with years of brewing, pouring into a cup. Power: a green steam haze rises and curls into soft wood-green motes about her. Background: rows of dark glossy tea bushes climbing a terrace in curving lines, soft mist hanging between them. Light: soft misty spirit-light from the upper left, steam glowing at its edges, a gentle rim on her cheek. Expression: an unhurried sleepy gentleness behind which nothing is rushed, eyes half closed in quiet pleasure.

people.imagined: She puts on a scowl for company, white wax on her sleeves, regretting the Cliff Hall every winter and admitting it to one friend.
people.subject: The moment: glaring at the viewer with a deliberate, performed scowl, the corner of her mouth twitching to give it away; she regrets the Cliff Hall every winter and admits it to one friend. Face, most important: a deliberate fierce scowl, brows drawn hard together, with a twitch of a smile at one corner. A sturdy, freckled, rosy face of thirty, fair, bright hazel eyes, thick brown brows, a short nose, a full mouth, nostrils flaring a little, scowl lines fresh and deliberate rather than deep. Hair: light brown, in a thick short plait tied with a white silk ribbon, a small jade pin. Body: sturdy, square, arms folded. Clothing: the Cliff Hall's pale ivory-grey silk in layered collars, neatly kept, a pale gauze over-robe with silver pine-and-cloud borders, white wax flecks spotting both cuffs like paint, a dark silk sash pulled tight with a small steel-grey jade clasp. Hands and objects: arms crossed over the chest, the wax-flecked cuffs showing. Power: a faint pale green sheen at her fingertips, a few cold green motes drifting in the frost air. Background: a grey rock ridge with a crooked pine, a stone wall, a pale sky heavy with winter, thin mist. Light: cold silver spirit-light from the upper left, a soft rim along her plait. Expression: stubborn and brave, impatient, a performed fierceness with a secret softness at the corner of the mouth.

people.imagined: He has built a second nine-square field in the forest for forty years and is nearly done. A stoop from the low branches.
people.subject: The moment: standing among tree trunks in dappled light, he looks up from under a low branch with quiet satisfaction at a nearly finished field. Face, most important: a deep forward stoop of the shoulders and neck, head tipped under a low branch, and a walnut-brown weathered face. Appearing about sixty-two, deep lines, patient brown eyes, grey bushy brows, a blunt nose, a calm mouth; a permanent pink line crosses his forehead where branches have struck it, his neck is thick and bent forward, his eyes deep-set with a tired gentleness. Hair: grey, in a knot with a walnut leaf and a plain jade pin. Body: bent, strong, long arms. Clothing: green-grey silk robes with the shoulders rubbed pale from branches and the hem dark with leaf-mould, in layered collars edged in faded silver sprout embroidery, a woven bark-silk belt holding a small mallet and a jade bead, a farmer's wide straw hat stitched with bark strips hanging at his back, his hands scarred and strong. Hands: one hand holding a small wooden stake marker. Power: a faint brown-green earth hint glows about his feet, a few gold-green motes rising from the soil. Background: a forest clearing opening onto a tilled square divided into nine plots by low stone borders, shafts of mist-light striping the soil between tall walnut trunks. Light: dappled green spirit-light from the upper left, a soft rim along his grey hair. Expression: a quiet satisfied smile with a stubborn set to the jaw and tired, content eyes looking up from the low branch.

people.imagined: The only man in the Hall of Rules with a pine-cut collar, writing a judgment in one book and a second book of the ones he thinks were wrong.
people.subject: The moment: at a clerk's desk in lamplight, he looks up from two books, one open and one hidden half under his arm, careful and just. Face, most important: a collar cut in a pine-palace style, wider with a deep V at the throat unlike the closed collars around him, and a second small book pressed under his arm. A neat, lean, serious face of thirty-eight, pale skin, steady dark eyes, level brows, a thin straight nose, a closed mouth, ink dotting his right cheekbone. Hair: black, tied up with a plain wooden pin. Body: slim, upright. Clothing: green-grey silk robes with the pine-palace collar in a deep V edged with a thin dark line, in startling contrast with the closed collars of his hall, a pale green silk under-collar, a plain dark silk sash with a small jade pendant, ink-black cuffs with faint silver cloud embroidery; the second book is bound with green cord. Hands: a brush in one hand, the book under the other arm. Power: a faint green hint lingers about the brush, a few pale motes over the page. Background: lacquered racks of bamboo slips lining the hall, a brass lamp on a chain, polished dark floorboards shining, all fading into shadow. Light: cool silver moonlight from the upper left, a warm lamp edge on the open page, a thin rim on his jaw. Expression: a careful even gaze with lips pressed in thought and level honest eyes.

people.imagined: The water-chestnut girl who followed peach petals up a stream and came back three days later, a peach-petal birthmark behind her ear.
people.subject: The moment: turning her head slightly to show a small mark behind her ear, eyes distant and dreamy as if remembering something she cannot; she followed peach petals up a stream and came back three days later. Face, most important: a small pink peach-petal-shaped birthmark the size of a thumbnail behind her left ear, shown by her tilted head, and her faraway gaze. A soft, round, dreamy face of thirty-five, light brown, wide slightly unfocused dark eyes under long lashes, soft arched brows, a small nose, a few freckles, a half-smile. Hair: black, in a loose braid over her right shoulder, a single pink petal caught in it, a jade hairpin. Body: slender, light. Clothing: flowing green-grey silk with a port-house blue-green silk sash knotted loosely, a translucent blue-green gauze over-robe with loose slightly-too-long sleeves, silver wave-and-petal embroidery at the collar, a hem perpetually damp and spotted with mud, a fine thread of pink petals caught in the weave of the collar. Hands and objects: a single pink peach petal held between two fingers. Power: a faint blue water shimmer round the petal, glowing pink-blue motes floating about her like drifting blossom. Background: a clear stream curling through green moss under a bank of peach trees heavy with blossom, petals drifting on the water in pink rafts, mist between the trunks. Light: soft pink-gold spirit-light from the upper left, a glowing rim along her braid. Expression: a gentle drifting half-smile with distant dreamy eyes, as if lost mid-memory.

people.imagined: Argues at dinner with her grandfather about an array, with his quick, bent walk caught in her stance as she leans forward.
people.subject: The moment: leaning forward across a lamp-lit dinner table, she argues with a raised finger and an eager grin, her shoulders bent in her grandfather's quick forward-leaning way. Face, most important: a sharp forward lean with one shoulder dropped like an old man's quick bent walk, and an eager open face. A lively, angular face of thirty, tan skin, bright dark eyes, strong arched brows, a straight nose, a wide grin; lean cheeks, mobile expressive brows, a small scar by her chin, a quick bright light in her eyes. Hair: black, in a high tail with a green silk cord and a silver pin. Body: lean, forward-bent, restless. Clothing: green-grey silk robes with chalk-white cuffs, wide sleeves embroidered at the borders with silver array lines, a green array-hall silk sash knotted tight and slung low with a jade tassel, a pale green gauze over-robe slipping off one shoulder, her elbow planted on the table. Hands: one hand raised with a finger, the other holding chopsticks. Power: a faint green shimmer plays about her raised finger as if sketching an array in the air, a few green motes. Background: a low round table crowded with bowls and dishes, a shared pot steaming, a plain wall softened by steam and shadow. Light: warm amber lamp-glow from the lower left, a pale silvery rim on her shoulder and tail. Expression: an eager grin with bright eyes and a raised brow, leaning in to press her point.

people.imagined: In the pill shop, he turns a jade thumb ring whenever he lies, selling cheap pills as the Healing House's stock.
people.subject: The moment: standing behind a shop counter, smiling smoothly while his thumb turns a jade ring on the other hand, selling cheap pills as the Healing House's stock. Face, most important: a thick pale-green jade ring turned round the thumb with the other hand, held visible at the chest, and a smooth friendly smile. A round, ruddy, handsome face of forty with shrewd brown eyes, neat brows, a short nose, a wide easy smile with well-worn creases, plump cheeks shaved to a blue-ish gloss, a thin carefully trimmed moustache. Hair: black, oiled, in a topknot with a green silk ribbon and a small jade crown-pin. Body: plump and comfortable. Clothing: green-grey silk robes with a silk-edged collar, a green brocade merchant's over-vest embroidered at the hem with tiny silver coins and herbs, a translucent green gauze over-robe, a dark green sash with a row of tiny blank pill-jar tags and jade beads hanging from it. Hands and objects: one hand turning the jade ring, the thumb moving over it whenever he lies. Power: a faint green gleam on the jade, soft green and gold motes drifting from the pill jars like glints of coin. Background: shelves of small lacquered pill jars in red and black, a brass scale on the counter, a hanging lantern, mist-soft shadows. Light: warm yellow lantern-light from the upper left with a cool silver rim from the doorway. Expression: pragmatic and gregarious, a greedy ease behind the smile, the glow of a man who has just sold something for more than it is worth.

people.imagined: The head's oldest disciple, happy at Trúc Cơ on the peak where the water ends, wind-grey hair to his waist.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a high windy peak where the water ends, his long grey hair streaming sideways, a contented smile as he looks out, happy at Trúc Cơ. Face, most important: very long wind-grey hair streaming out to one side down to his waist. A lean, brown, serene face of about fifty-five, lined by wind and sun, bright content unhurried dark eyes, long brows white as frost, a long nose and a quiet smile. Hair: silver-grey and loose, combed back by the wind, held at the crown by a single pale jade pin. Body: thin, straight, relaxed. Clothing: flowing robes of green-grey silk washed soft and pale and carefully mended in several shades of green, layered collars with faded silver herb-and-mist embroidery, a loose pale gauze over-robe streaming in the wind, a plain cord sash with a worn jade herb pendant and straw sandals; the faded colour is the choice of an old disciple who prefers it so. Hands and objects: one hand rests on a walking staff, a bare grey branch polished by use. Power: a pale blue wind-line curls in the air about him, faint blue-green motes streaming with his hair, a gentle aura of a long-settled cultivator. Background: a bare high peak dropping away into a sea of cloud, a few small birds wheeling far below, thin cold sunlight lighting a streak of rock. Light: bright clear silver spirit-light from the upper left, a luminous rim along the streaming hair. Expression: content and calm, the serene half-smile of a man who has nothing left to want from the view.
